prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman standing in front of a floor-to-ceiling glass window, with her body facing away from the camera at about 150°, hands naturally resting on the window frame, body leaning slightly forward, shoulders relaxed, head naturally looking back at the camera, eyes calm, confident, and soft, lips naturally closed.

A slender and athletic but not overly exaggerated figure, with a clear waistline, elegant shoulder and back lines, natural hip-to-leg proportions, long legs, one foot naturally on tiptoe with only the toes lightly touching the ground, giving an overall light posture.

Black sports bra (cross-back X-shape design with thin straps), black high-waisted tight sports shorts, high-end matte sports fabric, without any logos or text.

Deep brownish-black hair tied in a natural messy bun, with a small amount of loose hair falling naturally, realistic hair texture.

Modern high-rise apartment floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking a modern city CBD outside, buildings slightly blurred, cold-colored urban landscape in winter or early spring, glass with slight natural reflections.

Sunlight streaming in from the window around 9 AM, creating realistic backlighting and rim lighting, sunlight illuminating the shoulders, back, and edges of the hips and legs, skin with natural warm highlights, interior maintaining soft shadows, without using HDR.

Overall low-saturation tone, creamy colors, high-end commercial advertising style, in the style of Lululemon, Alo Yoga, Nike Women Campaign.

Negative Prompt: plastic skin, CGI, AI look, cartoon, illustration, oversaturated, HDR, distorted anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed legs, exaggerated hips, unrealistic muscles, glossy skin, watermark, logo, text, blur, low quality.

promptZh:
一位年轻的东亚女性站在落地窗前，身体背对镜头约 150°，双手自然地搭在窗框上，身体微微前倾，肩膀放松，头部自然回眸看向镜头，眼神平静、自信且柔和，双唇自然闭合。

身材苗条且富有运动感，但不显夸张，腰线清晰，肩背线条优雅，臀腿比例自然，双腿修长，一只脚自然踮起，仅脚尖轻触地面，整体姿态轻盈。

黑色运动内衣（交叉美背 X 型细肩带设计），黑色高腰紧身运动短裤，高端哑光运动面料，无任何标志或文字。

深棕黑色头发扎成自然的凌乱发髻，少量碎发自然垂落，发质真实。

现代高层公寓落地窗，俯瞰窗外现代城市 CBD，建筑略显模糊，呈现冬日或早春冷色调的城市景观，玻璃带有轻微的自然反光。

阳光从 上午 9 点 的窗外射入，营造出逼真的逆光和轮廓光，阳光照亮肩膀、背部以及臀部和腿部的边缘，皮肤带有自然的暖色高光，室内保持柔和的阴影，不使用 HDR。

整体低饱和度色调，奶油色系，高端商业广告风格，风格参考 Lululemon, Alo Yoga, Nike Women Campaign。

负面提示词：塑料感皮肤、CGI、AI 感、卡通、插画、过度饱和、HDR、解剖结构扭曲、手部畸形、多指、多肢、腿部变形、臀部夸张、肌肉不真实、皮肤油亮、水印、Logo、文字、模糊、低质量。
